method.aggregation: same production crem event machines in both paths

notes: One local ReqTx, ReqSn and three AckSn inputs, with admission checks, signatures and state aggregation; zero pre-applied backlog.
Complete ordered outcome/state equality and successful confirmation are checked before timing. The timed checksum forces structural projections, not every state field.
This compares the complete input conversion to frozen handlers/programs; it does not isolate input admission overhead. Both paths use crem event aggregation.
No network, persistence, API projection, saturated TPS or chain actions are measured. Earlier cluster measurements predate crem.
Four balanced grid runs, then ten-second repeats for large UTxOs, which have only four samples per implementation in the grid. Builds and tests were stopped.
Time changes are paired estimates, not confidence bounds. Drift and limited samples prevent claiming a general 5% bound.
Allocation rises about 56 KiB per round, including 8.6% in the small Simple fixture. Criterion reports some unavailable allocation interval bounds as null.
